# ADR-0006: Outbox now, regional CDC and durable bus later

Recorded: 11 October 2026. Retrospective project decision; not a bank governance approval.

## Status

Accepted; SQL polling/journal implemented, CDC/Kafka proposed

## Context

The thin lab must expose commit and delivery boundaries without introducing a full messaging platform.

## Decision

Use a transactional outbox in the federation harness and a local transactional change journal in the migration slice. Pilot evolution is regional CockroachDB CDC feeding independently budgeted durable transport such as Kafka after authorized projection.

## Alternatives

Application dual writes to database and bus; raw global CDC mirroring; snapshot-only migration.

## Consequences

The lab is easy to run but is not a CDC/broker benchmark. CDC duplicates and lacks whole-transaction ordering; preserve versions, tombstones, manifests, inboxes and target-applied checkpoints.

## Evidence

poc/app.py; poc/operational.py; poc/migration.py; WORK_ISOLATION.md

## Gate

Crash between target commit and acknowledgement, reorder events and lose transport. Never treat a source watermark alone as proof of target application.
